posthog.recommendedProjectShape: Use one PostHog project for youarepayingtoomuch.com and smarterwaywealth.com so the cross-site journey can be analyzed in one place.

env.NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY: Public PostHog project key used by both sites.

sharedProperties.site_domain: Current hostname, used to split YAPTOM and SWW traffic.
sharedProperties.first_landing_url: Sanitized first landing origin/path and approved UTM fields only; never raw calculator inputs.
sharedProperties.first_landing_domain: First landing hostname registered for the browser/person.
sharedProperties.campaign_attribution_method: Current arrivals: explicit_utm or legacy_qr_signature. clean_root_launch is historical only; fresh ordinary/shared arrivals clear prior campaign context.
sharedProperties.legacy_eddm_qr: True when the exact untagged URL embedded in the 2026 printer proofs supplied the EDDM attribution.
sharedProperties.self_test: True for owner exclusion or session-only phone verification. Normal prospect aggregates exclude these events.
sharedProperties.qr_verification: True in phone verification mode; the server cookie or explicit boolean request flag opts activity into separate test totals. False cannot override a server test cookie. Verification can override owner exclusion, never robot exclusion.

events.name: eddm_qr_landed
events.purpose: One receipt-confirmed mailed QR document opening, including reopening/reloading the printed address.
semanticRules: Emit once per accepted qualifying document opening after the server receipt; retries, rerenders and parameter cleanup keep that opening ID.

Resolve from the arriving URL on youarepayingtoomuch.com/www root only: exact portfolio=1000000&years=20&growth=8&fee=1 signature or full approved launch_5k/print/qr_code UTMs. Reject duplicate parameters, shared=1 and older calculator-result additions such as flat/mfe. Ordinary default homepages do not qualify.

New share links carry shared=1 and remove EDDM UTMs. Fresh ordinary/shared document arrivals clear stale campaign context; legitimate campaign conversion events retain context within the current document.

Normal owner/selftest and recognized bots/automation create no normal QR receipt/event. qrtest=1 enables session-only separately labeled verification; qrtest=0 or Exit test clears it. Verification sets self_test:true and qr_verification:true; bots/automation remain excluded.
measurement_version is 05-66; qr_opening_id correlates the receipt; qr_first_browser comes from that receipt; qr_verification is always explicit false/true.
Sanitize $current_url to origin/path and approved UTM keys; never include calculator assumptions in this event URL.

Preserve exact count/visits and daily fields and saved historical mixed totals without reset/backfill. Add QR openings and per-metric start dates; QR opening coverage is null until its first accepted opening.

Private server dedup markers store SHA-256 hashes of random anonymous browser/opening identifiers, boolean seen flags and timestamps only. Public GET exposes aggregates; never expose/store raw IDs, URLs, IPs, calculator values or personal information in receipts.

events.name: calculator_submitted
events.purpose: Instant result rendered after the visitor customizes calculator assumptions.

events.name: cta_clicked
events.purpose: Shared catch-all for meaningful outbound, intro, contact, or explicitly tagged CTAs.
semanticRules: On youarepayingtoomuch.com, home_post_calculator_primary/secondary and home_post_faq_primary/secondary identify the same two CTA choices at distinct homepage positions.

events.name: firm_site_viewed
events.purpose: SWW-specific pageview companion event for firm-site journey funnels.

events.name: calculator_cta_clicked
events.purpose: Firm-site click back to the fee calculator.

events.name: pricing_or_model_viewed
events.purpose: Future event for explicit pricing/model section exposure once SWW gets a durable section marker or route.

privacyRules: Do not capture Social Security numbers, account numbers, full phone numbers, email addresses typed into forms, or free-form personal financial notes.
Calculator numeric assumptions may be captured because they are anonymous modeling inputs, but do not combine them with identified user profiles without a new compliance/privacy review.
PostHog session replay may show calculator numbers. Password, email, and telephone inputs must stay masked.
Sentry should receive technical error context, not marketing funnel payloads or sensitive user-entered financial details.

The public mailer counter exposes aggregates only. Its private dedup markers store hashed anonymous random IDs, seen flags and timestamps; never raw browser IDs, URLs, IPs, numeric calculator inputs or personal information. History remains unchanged.
